backend_url.description: The HTTPS base URL of your Vobiz calling backend, with no trailing slash — for example https://calling.example.com. Each agent signs in to the panel with their own Freshdesk login, so there is nothing per agent to set here. See docs/backend-contract.md in the repository for what this service must implement.

registrar_url.description: SIP-over-WebSocket URL of the Vobiz registrar. Leave blank unless Vobiz support has given you a different one.
